threat_event: Ransomware on the shop laptop encrypts the custom records copy, label templates, cut sheets, and cure sheet, and steals the passwords saved in the browser
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner works in the administrator account; browser stores every shop password; no backup of local files; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 laptop; SYS-04 labels; BP-02, BP-03, BP-05
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (administrator account used daily; every password in the browser; no backup); EV-029 (no security training found)
existing_controls: Automatic OS updates; built-in antivirus; full-disk encryption
treatment_plan: Standard user account for daily work; password manager and clear the browser store; business file plan with version history plus monthly encrypted drive backup; free security course; P08 runbook

threat_event: Attacker signs in to the cold-chain account and the smokehouse app with the shared password, silences or redirects alerts, or changes a cook program
threat_source: Cybercriminal (password reuse or theft from the browser)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One password for SYS-01 and SYS-02, also used on a personal shopping account; no MFA on SYS-01; SYS-02 offers none; remote program editing was on until 2026-08-03
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 cold-chain; SYS-02 smokehouse; BP-01, BP-03
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (browser flags the shared password); EV-001 (no MFA on SYS-01); EV-006 (no MFA offered; remote editing on); EV-IA-5 (password also used on a personal shopping account; P07 test 2026-07-29)
existing_controls: Remote program editing off since 2026-08-03; smokehouse panel PIN changed 2026-07-29
treatment_plan: Unique passphrases in a password manager; MFA on SYS-01; monthly review of the SYS-01 activity log and the smokehouse program list; cook programs printed for comparison

threat_event: A cooler or freezer warms overnight and nobody is alerted, because the gateway lost power or internet or the only phone missed the alert
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single alert path to one phone; gateway on wall power with no battery; offline notice off; no second contact; no written outage procedure
affected_asset_or_process: Walk-in cooler and freezer; SYS-01; SYS-06; BP-01
likelihood_basis: EV-002 (one alert contact; offline notice off); EV-005 (gateway cannot alert while offline); EV-020 (gateway on wall power); EV-029 (no outage procedure)
existing_controls: Dial thermometers read at opening and closing; refrigeration contractor's 24-hour line
treatment_plan: Turn on the offline notice; battery backup for gateway and router; second alert contact under a reciprocal agreement with a neighboring custom processor; hourly manual readings when alerts are down (POL-01 11.2)

threat_event: The custom records spreadsheet, cook programs, cure sheet, or label templates are lost or corrupted (deletion, sync error, ransomware, device failure)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single copy of each; no version history; no backup; no retention rule
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 and SYS-03 records; SYS-02 programs; BP-03, BP-05
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (no version history); EV-012 (single spreadsheet); EV-006 (cook programs not copied); EV-008 (templates and cure sheet only on the laptop); EV-029 (no retention rule)
existing_controls: None beyond the vendors' own backups
treatment_plan: Business file plan with version history; monthly export of records and programs to an encrypted drive kept in the house; printed cook programs; retention rule (POL-01 8.6)

threat_event: A cure or brine amount scaled with the public AI chatbot, or a mistyped cure sheet, exceeds the curing agent limits and the batch is made
threat_source: Owner error relying on an AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot answers used without a documented check; one of 12 saved answers was about 25% high; cure sheet has no version control
affected_asset_or_process: BP-03 curing; SYS-10; SYS-03 cure sheet
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (chatbot used for cure scaling); EV-023 (no check recorded on batch sheets); EV-033 (1 of 12 saved answers about 25% high)
existing_controls: Owner usually compares with the cure supplier's printed chart (not written down)
treatment_plan: Cure amounts only from the supplier's chart or a locked cure sheet checked against it; a chatbot answer is never the source (P10); record the check on each batch sheet

threat_event: Someone on the shop Wi-Fi (a customer's phone or a nearby device) reaches the router admin page, the smokehouse controller, or the gateway
threat_source: Opportunistic attacker on the local network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat network; customers given the Wi-Fi password; router default password until 2026-07-29; firmware never updated
likelihood_basis: EV-019 (flat network; label password; no firmware update); EV-020 (customers given the Wi-Fi password); EV-SC-7 (a phone on the Wi-Fi reached the router and controller)
existing_controls: Router and panel default passwords changed 2026-07-29; router blocks inbound internet traffic
treatment_plan: Guest network for customers; separate network for the gateway and smokehouse; update router firmware

threat_event: Phishing or a fake payment-change message leads to a stolen email password or a misdirected payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer email account used for business and personal mail; text-message MFA; no training
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (consumer account; text-message MFA); EV-015 (one-time code for new payees); EV-031 (payment requests arrive by email); EV-029 (no training)
existing_controls: MFA by text message on email; bank one-time code for new payees
treatment_plan: Free security course; confirm any payment change by phone; move email MFA to an authenticator app with the business plan

threat_event: Customer names and addresses in the custom records, cut sheets, or kill sheet photos are disclosed (lost phone, an over-shared file link, or paper left behind the counter)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records possibly personal information under the 2026 statute; paper in open boxes; tax preparer folder shared by link; no disposal rule
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 records; SYS-06 photos; paper cut sheets
likelihood_basis: EV-012 (about 640 owners' names and addresses); EV-020 (paper in open boxes); EV-011 (shared export link); EV-009 (kill sheet photos on the phone)
existing_controls: Phone encrypted with a passcode; laptop encrypted
treatment_plan: Shred old paper beyond the retention period; replace the shared link with a dated, expiring share; delete kill sheet photos from the phone after entry; counsel opinion on the geolocation question

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable (illness, injury, or travel) or without the phone, so nobody answers alerts, reaches the accounts, or returns customers' product
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; only alert recipient; no backup person or written emergency sheet
likelihood_basis: EV-018 (no employees); EV-002 (only alert recipient); EV-030 (BIA worksheet)
treatment_plan: Reciprocal agreement with a neighboring custom processor (alerts, cooler space, and calling customers); sealed envelope with recovery codes and a cooler emergency sheet held by a trusted family member

threat_event: A hurricane or long utility outage cuts power to the shop for more than 4 hours and the walk-ins warm
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No standby generator or transfer switch; no emergency cooler space agreement
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (no standby generator); EV-016 (no emergency cooler space agreement); EV-031 (storm practice not written down)
existing_controls: Owner watches storm forecasts and stops taking carcasses when a storm is forecast (not written down)
treatment_plan: Written storm procedure (no new carcasses 72 hours before forecast landfall; freezer full and closed); generator transfer switch for the condensing units; emergency cooler space agreement

threat_event: The cold-chain vendor's platform or its text-message delivery service is down and alerts are not delivered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency for real-time alerts
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (vendor availability testing and carve-outs); EV-020 (dial thermometers read twice a day)
existing_controls: Vendor availability commitments tested in its SOC 2 report (P09); dial thermometers read twice a day
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. App notifications and text messages arrive by different routes; manual readings continue

threat_event: The public AI chatbot vendor keeps and uses recipe prompts or customer first names entered by the owner
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer terms allow use of inputs to improve the service; no rule on what may be entered
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (terms allow use of inputs); EV-024 (first names in some drafts; training setting on)
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low, with the POL-01 9.5 rule: no customer names, addresses, or phone numbers in any AI tool; training setting off where offered

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized, or a food safety or notice decision is made late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or training; owner unaware the shop is a covered entity under Fla. Stat. 501.171
likelihood_basis: EV-029 (no incident plan, contact list or training); EV-032 (owner unaware of covered entity status)
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and printed contacts; walk through it with the IT technician

threat_event: Labels cannot be printed or print the wrong owner's name, so packages leave without a correct "Not for Sale" label
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Label templates exist only on the laptop; no check of labels against the cut sheet at pickup
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (templates only on the laptop); EV-010 (preprinted label roll)
existing_controls: Preprinted "Not for Sale" label roll; owner checks names at pickup
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Back up the templates with the other records (R-004)

threat_event: The laptop or phone is stolen from the shop or the truck
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Devices travel between shop, house, and truck
likelihood_basis: EV-031 (devices travel between shop, house and truck); EV-008; EV-009 (both devices encrypted)
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption on the laptop; passcode and encryption on the phone
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Turn on find-and-wipe for both devices
